fields.appearance: Impeccably dressed with a family signet and the composed posture of lifelong scrutiny.
fields.backstory: Raised as the spare heir, they unexpectedly inherited after a succession of family tragedies.
fields.goals: Stabilize the estate, uncover the tragedies' cause, and become worthy of an unwanted title.

fields.appearance: Fashionable but understated, with sharp eyes and a smile practiced for court.
fields.backstory: A minor courtier survived by carrying messages between rivals without openly choosing a side.
fields.goals: Gain an independent office and prevent the court from consuming the few people they trust.

fields.appearance: Young, carefully groomed, and visibly uncomfortable in ceremonial clothing.
fields.backstory: An idealistic heir was educated abroad and returned to find the family profiting from abuse.
fields.goals: Reform the domain without provoking a coup from relatives or retainers.

fields.appearance: Weathered for an aristocrat, wearing quality riding clothes and an old dueling scar.
fields.backstory: A minor lord spent years personally defending an isolated border holding ignored by the crown.
fields.goals: Secure protection for the tenants and force the capital to acknowledge the frontier.

fields.appearance: Elegant, silver-haired, and supported by a cane concealing a narrow blade.
fields.backstory: A widowed aristocrat rebuilt influence through marriages, favors, and impeccable memory.
fields.goals: Arrange a peaceful succession and settle one dangerous debt before age removes the opportunity.

fields.appearance: Clothing and tools immediately suggest the work of a sovereign.
fields.backstory: Built a life as a sovereign and knows the profession’s obligations and hidden pressures.
fields.goals: Use that experience to secure a safer and more independent future.

fields.appearance: Clothing and tools immediately suggest the work of a prince.
fields.backstory: Built a life as a prince and knows the profession’s obligations and hidden pressures.
fields.goals: Use that experience to secure a safer and more independent future.

fields.appearance: Clothing and tools immediately suggest the work of a noble.
fields.backstory: Built a life as a noble and knows the profession’s obligations and hidden pressures.
fields.goals: Use that experience to secure a safer and more independent future.

fields.appearance: An impeccably polite noble carries ledgers comparing the civilian cost of both sides in a rebellion.
fields.backstory: an impeccably polite noble funding both sides of a rebellion to minimize civilian casualties.
fields.goals: Turn this unusual history toward a self-directed future.

fields.appearance: A tiny crown, coded messages, and underground maps suggest a rat monarch's court.
fields.backstory: a self-proclaimed rat monarch commanding an excellent spy network beneath the capital.
fields.goals: Turn this unusual history toward a self-directed future.
